purpose: A small marker on or next to something: a status word such as Draft, a count of new items, or a dot.

props.name: variant
props.description: Kind of badge. Defaults to status

props.name: label
props.description: Status text, or what a count or dot means (for example unread messages)

props.name: max
props.description: Counts above this show as max+. Defaults to 99

props.name: tone
props.description: Colour role. Counts use primary or danger. Defaults to neutral

whenToUse: To show a status such as Draft or Live
To show how many new items there are
whenNotToUse: As a clickable filter — use Tag
antiPatterns: A dot whose meaning is only its colour

anatomy: Status: square tonal fill with text; count: square solid fill with a number; dot: 8px square
typography: `type-caption-size` in SemiCondensed at the overline weight
states: Status on `color-container-*` with `color-on-container-*`; count on `color-interactive-default` or `color-text-danger` with `color-text-inverse`

a11yNotes: Counts read as the full number and its meaning (visually hidden text); the capped digits are hidden from assistive tech
Dots are role img with a label, so meaning is not colour alone
